इशीका इशीका, f. an elephant's eyeball.
See इषीका.
इषिका = इषीका and ईषिका, q. v.

इषीक, अस्, m., N. of a people, = ऐषीक; (आ),
f. reed, rush, stem or stalk of grasses; an arrow; a
sort of sugar-cane, Saccharum Spontaneum; a brush;
a small stick of wood or iron used for trying whether
or not the gold in a crucible is melted; the eyeball
of an elephant; see इषिका, ईषिका, ईषीका, इशीका.
—इषीक-तूल, अम्, n. the point or upper part of
a reed.

ईषिका ईषिका, f. an elephant's eyeball; a
painter's brush, &c.; a weapon, a dart or arrow. See
इषीका and ईषीका.

ईषीका ईषीका, f. a painter's brush, a fibrous
stick used as one; an ingot-mould; a dipping rod or
something cast into a crucible to examine if the
metal it contains is in fusion. See ईक्षिका.

इषित, अस्, आ, अम्, moved, driven, tossed, sent;
caused, excited, animated; quick.
—इषित-त्वता, ind.,
Ved. by impulse or excitement.
ईषिर ईषिर, अस्, m. fire. See इषिर.

ईशितृ, ता, m. a master, an owner or proprietor; a
king.

ईशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, commanding, reigning; (इनी), f.
supremacy.
—ईशि-ता, f. or ईशि-त्व, अम्, n. superiority,
supremacy, one of the eight attributes of Śiva.
